title: Discipleship
definition: Discipleship is the lifelong process of following Jesus, learning His Word, obeying His commands, and being formed into His likeness.
summary: Discipleship is the lifelong process of following Jesus, learning His Word, obeying His commands, and being formed into His likeness.
christFocus: Jesus calls people to Himself, teaches them to follow, and empowers them by the Holy Spirit to live as His disciples.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Discipleship begins with coming to Jesus and continues through a whole life of learning to follow Him. It is not merely a class, program, or information path; it is life under the lordship of Christ.

A disciple learns from Scripture, grows in prayer, practices obedience, repents of sin, serves others, endures hardship, and joins the mission of making other disciples.

Discipleship is empowered by the Holy Spirit. Believers cannot become like Christ through self-effort alone; they are formed by grace, truth, community, and the Spirit’s work.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers have been told to grow but never taught what following Jesus looks like in ordinary life. Discipleship gives a clear path: know Christ, abide in Christ, obey Christ, and help others follow Christ.

This doctrine also speaks to people who feel unusable. Jesus makes disciples out of weak, ordinary, restored people and sends them for His purposes.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Follow Jesus today in one practical way. Receive His Word, deny yourself where needed, rely on the Spirit, and look for someone you can encourage toward faithful obedience.
